actualInterference: Real fixture filesystem operations run after the first backup-read chunk, before private copy/restamp and final publication. Replacement uses independent equal-byte B and a later FD-applied mtime; timestamp-only keeps the inode; locks are exclusive real files preserved by Core.
oracles: Native Git staged B remains B after refusal
Native Git backup image remains A
Index bytes, inode and mtime remain the injected foreign image
Backups and pending journal bytes unchanged across repeated recovery
HEAD, MAIN bytes and refs preserved
Exact known B recovery succeeds once and a repeated completed recovery preserves the index
automaticRollbackErrorPolicy: The synthetic original EIO remains the caller error when the automatic rollback is blocked by the late MAIN lock; the pending journal and lock remain. Subsequent explicit recover calls return LOCKED. This preserves the existing original-error policy.
scope: Six selected regressions, not a complete frontier/full campaign and not added to earlier directed denominators. The subsequent full V5 has its own complete corpus, raw output receipts and frozen global source manifest in RESULTS.md.
independentReadOnlyReview: Publication peer reviewed the target identity checks, all-index lock guard, automatic rollback reuse and explicit metadata/completion/checkpoint/protection boundaries; no blocker found in those optimistic boundaries.
provenance: Counts, durations and exit codes were observed in executor outputs. Source hashes were observed after the directed run. No raw-output file hash or global before/after proof is invented by this projection.
